items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I don't know what Eddie Groce, I don't know what he was, but he was very quiet. He was a nice man.

ctx.x: Oh no. How do girls dress?

What do they wear? They wear like nice gay them dresses, clean. It's regular dresses. Yeah. See women's land made their money on their legs, big legs. And you see the legs up to the air back in those days, man. Rain, I used to pay a dime to go downtown, a nickel. I used to see women get on the street called Ray's dress up so I could look at the legs. Because you didn't see no look at the wood of dresses starting. Oh I see, yeah. That thing going? Yeah. Yeah. That's good. And now the cribs, you see that was in the…
What kind of a band did they have there? We had a seven-piece band.
